calls.statement:
SELECT m.home_store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.home_store_id IN (115, 116, 117, 136, 900) 
  AND m.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY m.home_store_id
ORDER BY m.home_store_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS customer_count
FROM dim_store s
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND m.is_current = TRUE
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.format
ORDER BY s.store_id
